verdict.rationale: Brex's Payments API is documented as letting users manage vendors and send ACH, domestic wires, and checks. Bill pay is listed as a core platform module alongside AI-powered invoice entry, approval, and payments, and Pipedream integration docs mention sending vendor payments. The evidence is only brief one-line descriptions, though. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the finance-lead payment workflow (vendor setup, approvals, ACH vs wire handling in the UI), independent or hands-on corroboration that vendor ACH/wire payments work as described.
